name: dsh-vision-insights-plugin
description: LinkHealth Vision Insights for DeepSeek Harness: DSH-side access point for vision insights. The OpenVINO visual apps (Intelligent Queue Management, Automated Self-Checkout) are separate applications sharing one insight storage layer (SQLite behind a thin read API); this plugin's query_vision_events and query_checkout_events tools read that data source via a baseUrl config entry — deterministic facts, LLM narrates.
